values.meaning: bonus movement speed for Senna and allies in Wraith Form
time without stealth-breaking actions before regaining camouflage
values.binNote: wiki states 1.75, bin value is 1.5; disagreement between sources.

mechanics.claim: Senna gains camouflage for the effect duration and quickly regains it after breaking stealth if she performs no stealth-breaking actions.
mechanics.quote: gains {{tip|camouflage}} for a duration. If '''Senna''' {{tip|breaks stealth|breaks the camouflage}}, she regains it after {{fd|1.75}} seconds without performing actions that break stealth.

mechanics.claim: Using a basic attack breaks stealth at the start of the attack windup, and refreshes the stealth-regain timer.
mechanics.quote: Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.

mechanics.claim: Wraith Form ends immediately upon Senna's death.
Senna can move during the ability's cast time.
mechanics.quote: '''''Senna''' can move during Curse of the Black Mist's cast time.''

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts after the effect (post-cast), not on cast.
